Bug_Title: JUnit5 test classes and methods should not be silently ignored
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates several cases where JUnit5 will ignore test methods and classes due to incorrect visibility or method properties. Specifically, private test methods, static test methods, methods returning a value, and test methods within private nested classes will be ignored by JUnit5 without warning.
